changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: No query leads with event_type: each one that filters on it also filters on the workspace or the target, which idx_activity_event_workspace_covering and idx_activity_event_target serve. Every activity write still updated this index. CONCURRENTLY drops it without blocking writes.
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_activity_event_type_time

rollback.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_activity_event_type_time ON activity_event (event_type, occurred_at)
